name: Momo x Momi ~Watashi, Iyashichaimasu~
original_name: もも×もみ～私、癒しちゃいます～
source:
Our protagonist is a master of therapeutics, and is so prolific that he’s opened his own practice despite his young age. However, despite his skills, the industry has hit a bit of a slump recently. Despite that, he’s found a practically angelic woman who has sworn her help until the end. With the boost of confidence, he has devised a new angle to his business. Under the guise of a “Relaxation Room” our hero gets commissioned by both a schoolgirl and a college student interested in the practice; a bisexual who’s seeking eternal beauty; as well as an unsuspecting married woman.

[From White Masq]
translation:
我们的主角是一位治疗学大师，而且多产，以至于他在年轻的时候就开设了自己的诊所。然而，尽管他技术精湛，但该行业最近却遭遇了一些低迷。尽管如此，他还是找到了一位几乎天使般的女人，她发誓会帮助他直到最后。信心增强后，他为自己的事业找到了新的视角。在“休闲室”的幌子下，我们的英雄受到了一名对这种练习感兴趣的女学生和一名大学生的委托；追求永恒美丽的双性恋；以及一个毫无戒心的已婚妇女。

[来自白色面膜]
